writeup: This is the Guess Jewel U1289L3, a 34mm rose gold watch with a mesh bracelet, a crystal-set bezel and a Roman numeral sunray dial. Woot has it new for $52.99, while the in-stock stores we found charge the equivalent of about $118 to $125, and the US retailers we checked are sold out.
